text:
alex_sales: Heads-up — AcmeCorp just re-opened the integration ask. They want native Terraform provider + SCIM/SSO integration, and marketplace listing. They said it's a blocker for procurement.
emma_support: +1, ticket #4521 has detailed compliance checklist. Customer willing to sign a 12mo commitment if we ship a supported Terraform provider and Okta SCIM.
mia_product: Thanks — can we get a quick intake triage here. Need proposed scope, acceptance criteria, rough ETA, and expected maintenance cost.
jenna_cs: Customer asked for: 1) provider to provision Redwood model endpoints and credentials 2) SCIM to sync users/groups from Okta 3) marketplace listing and onboarding docs. They need RBAC mapping and audit logs.
sangeeta_eng: Quick reality check: Terraform provider + SCIM minimal surface is doable but depends on how deep we go on RBAC/audit. We can scope SCIM to core user/group CRUD + group membership events in phase 1. Audit log export might be phase 2.
ryan_devex: Proposed triage tags to attach to backlog: `[integration:terraform]`, `[integration:scim-sso]`, `[marketplace]`, `[customer:acme]`, `[priority:P0-revenue]`, `[owner:devex]`.
triage-bot: Created intake issue RDW-INT-777 and linked ticket #4521.
alex_sales: Revenue signal: $480k ARR if they commit to Dedicated and marketplace onboarding. Sales needs go/no-go by end of quarter.
mia_product: Ok. Two asks for product: 1) a minimal launch checklist/acceptance criteria we can share with sales 2) rough delivery ETA (weeks).
sangeeta_eng: Rough engineering estimate: 3-4 sprints to design + prototype provider + SCIM minimal, then 1 sprint for hardening and QA, assuming we allocate one full eng pair + devex support. So 6 sprints total => ~9 weeks. Risk: SCIM edge-cases (enterprise Okta mappings) could add time.
ryan_devex: Draft acceptance criteria (quick):
```
- Terraform provider: resources to create `redwood_endpoint`, `redwood_policy`, support for provider versioning and import.
- Provider docs: examples for host modes (hosted, dedicated, private) and secrets handling.
- SCIM: support Users (create/update/delete), Groups (create/update/delete), Group membership sync, consistent 2xx/4xx error handling, rate limiting behavior documented.
- SSO: Okta OIDC config guide + automated test in CI (okta sandbox).
- Marketplace: listing metadata + basic install flow + sample terraform snippet.
- Auditability: exportable logs to customer's KMS or syslog (phase 2 ok but must be documented as future work).
- Backwards compatibility: provider must allow importing existing endpoints.
```
ryan_devex: Suggest delivery milestone breakdown: M1 (design + RFC): 1 sprint, M2 (provider prototype + basic ops): 2 sprints, M3 (SCIM prototype + tests): 2 sprints, M4 (hardening + docs + marketplace prep): 1 sprint.
mia_product: That looks good. Can we tighten to 7 weeks if we deprioritize audit export and marketplace polishing?
sangeeta_eng: Possibly 7. Need dedicated eng allocation. Also need more clarity on E2E test infra for Okta — will require sandbox credentials.
jenna_cs: I'll request sandbox access from customer. Also confirm which Okta features they use (SCIM extension schema?).
emma_support: Noted — I'll attach the support runbook and current ticket to the intake issue.
alex_sales: Sales asks product to mark this [customer-commit] in backlog so we can communicate to customer roadmap.
ryan_devex: I'll create the backlog issue template and include these tags + checklist. Suggested issue title: `integration: terraform + scim — acmecorp (enterprise commit)` and assign `owner:devex`.
triage-bot: Linked RDW-INT-777 to backlog item RDW-B-1903.
mia_product: Final ask: Product will require a short launch criteria doc for procurement: bullet points we can sign off on. Ryan, can you draft and attach by EOD tomorrow?
ryan_devex: Yup, will drop a PR with draft acceptance criteria and a skeleton RFC.
sangeeta_eng: One more technical note: we should version the provider under org `redwoodio` on registry, and publish a beta to test registry first.
alex_sales: Thanks all. If we can confirm 7–9 week window and tag as customer-commit, sales will push legal and procurement.
mia_product: Great. I'll update roadmap board with provisional milestone and label `needs-dev-alloc`.
jenna_cs: I'll follow up with customer on Okta schema and sandbox creds.
emma_support: Any blockers for CI/infra? Will need a temporary dedicated test account for provisioning.
sangeeta_eng: We can use existing infra but want separate env. Need cloud infra budget sign-off.
alex_sales: I'll loop finance.
mia_product: Thanks team — keeping this thread for triage updates. Please add quick replies only. :handshake:
